ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

2. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

3. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

4. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

5. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

6. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

8. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.

9. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

10. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

11. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

13. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

14. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earthing and Excess Current Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Inspection and Testing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Power Supplies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Measuring Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
